title: Co-Branded Card Award of Summit Upgrade Certificates
content:
A choice-benefit certificate issue in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program carries a card certificate award that follows the companion certificate issued on a Crestline co-branded card anniversary, as its record under the Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes charter shows it.

| Card-anniversary companion certificate | Issued within the last 12 months | Certificates added |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Companion Certificate First or Premium Economy | Yes | 2 |
| Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin or Main Plus | Yes | 1 |
| No such certificate issued in that span | | None |

The award is a whole number of certificates added to the issue.

**Recency.** Within the last 12 months means fewer than 12 whole calendar months from the certificate's issue date to the day of the issue; a card certificate issued on 22 January 2025 is inside the span on 21 January 2026 and outside it on 22 January 2026.

**Hypothetical reading.** A member whose card-anniversary certificate is a Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin issued in the past two months receives 1 added certificate; the same certificate issued 15 months ago adds none.
